thread:
carla: starting a quick onboarding thread for customer Novellus — merged their LoRA into our 13B base and ran the int4 compile+eval. noticed a spike in hallucination on the FAQ QA set (expected acc drop small, but this is larger). attaching quick paste of top-line results.
ben: can you paste the short table here? quick glance is fine.
carla: sure — trimmed to the essentials: 
```
model_variant | quant | qa_acc | rougeL | avg_latency
novellus-lora+base | fp16 | 0.92 | 0.71 | 120ms
novellus-lora+base | int4  | 0.83 | 0.68 | 95ms
novellus-lora+base | int8  | 0.90 | 0.70 | 110ms
```
carla: failure mode: hallucination examples up ~10% (free-form answers inventing steps). promptset = novellus_faq_v2 (50 q).
emily: that int4 drop is bigger than expected. did tokenizer alignment change during the merge? any added special tokens from customer fine-tune?
carla: good call — customer added two markers: <CUST_TITLE> and <CUST_SIG>. merge script should have kept vocab stable but LORA can expose tokenization sensitivities. I ran a quick token distribution diff: their training set has 12k occurrences of <CUST_TITLE> mapped to an unk-ish bytepair.
frank: i ran a local with per-channel scales + outlier clipping for int4 and got qa_acc 0.87. not as good as int8 but better. command I used: 
```bash
./quantize --model novellus-lora+base --bits 4 --group-size 128 --outlier-clipping 3.0 --per-channel
```
frank: latency stayed ~97ms.
gina: can we try a tokenmap pass that remaps those special tokens to reserved ids (or add them to tokenizer) and rerun int4? that often fixes weird generative shifts. I'll queue an evalpack (qp-nov-03) with both tokenmap and without to compare.
carla: added — evalpack queued (qp-nov-03). also adding deterministic seed + greedy sampling to isolate randomness.
ben: also include a run that disables rotary scaling (we've seen int4 rpe issues before).
emily: FYI, small check: KV cache offsets are identical between fp16 and int4? sometimes padding differences change position tracking and cause hallucination on multi-turn QA.
carla: checked KV lengths for a handful of examples, they match. but will do an automated trace for a failing prompt.
infra-bot: deploy-notification: evalpack qp-nov-03 scheduled on cluster dev-gpu-05 at 2026-03-21T15:30Z (owner: gina).
gina: will attach diffs and per-prompt failure samples once qp finishes. planning: tokenmap -> int4 quant with group-size 128 -> int4 with per-channel scaling -> int8 baseline.
frank: suggest also running tiny calibration on 256 random in-domain snippets (makes int4 more stable).
carla: agreed. task list: 1) tokenmap patch + retrain tokenizer vocab tiling (gina) 2) int4 per-channel + outlier clipping (frank) 3) evalpack qp-nov-03 + calibration 256 (carla) 4) compare to int8 baseline and produce a one-pager for CS with actionable rollback/fallback (ben).
ben: cool — if results still bad we can fall back to int8 as customer SLA path. will prep rollback note.
emily: tagging model-ops to consider permanent token addition for cusom tokens if this repeats.
carla: thanks all — will post qp results in this thread. :thumbsup:
